evaluation_samples.prompt: How does South Indian fermentation in idlis and dosas improve nutrition?
evaluation_samples.expected: Degrades phytic acid, improves B-vitamin availability, enhances protein digestibility.

evaluation_samples.prompt: What are optimal Indian plant-based sources of bioavailable iron?
evaluation_samples.expected: Dark leafy greens, black chickpeas, bajra, amaranth combined with vitamin C (amla, lemon).

comparison_table.description: Correctly identifying regional Indian food names without hallucination
Standardizing pieces, katori, bowl, cup, grams
Detecting missing gram weights instead of guessing
Adhering strictly to JSON output schema without preamble
Base model invents arbitrary calorie numbers; LoRA strictly defers to MongoDB

sample_evaluations.prompt: I had 2 idlis with one bowl of sambar for breakfast.
sample_evaluations.base_model_output: Idli (~300 kcal each), Sambar (~400 kcal) = 1000 kcal total (Hallucinated nutrition)
sample_evaluations.lora_model_output: JSON extracted: idli (qty: 2 pieces, g: null), sambar (qty: 1 bowl, g: null). Requires clarification on weights before calculation.

sample_evaluations.prompt: Lunch was 2 chapatis, dal tadka, and a bowl of curd.
sample_evaluations.base_model_output: Conversational paragraph without strict JSON fields; assumed 60g roti and 250 kcal dal.
sample_evaluations.lora_model_output: Strict JSON schema with matched Anuvaad items, flagging missing portion gram conversions.
